LB::prime
Description
Prime server connections
Syntax
LB
::
prime
$pool_name
LB::prime
Sets up serverside connections before client traffic comes. The
connection will be made to the specific pool or the default server
pool in this virtual server.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
LB
::
prime
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
